The future resurrection is hinted at in passages like John 5:28-29, which speaks of the dead hearing His voice and coming forth, some to life and some to judgment. results.message: I asked what the people do, not only when they rise.
results.preview: After they are raised, God's people will be gathered to Christ and will reign with Him for a thousand years. This is described in **Revelation 20:4-6**, which states that they will reign with Christ. Additionally, **1 Thessalonians 4:16-17** explains that the dead in Christ will rise first, and then those who are alive will be caught up together with them to meet the Lord in the air. This gathering signifies a special union with Christ and a time of reigning with Him.
